title: Microsoft Purview: view-only role management for Global Reader and Security Reader
summary: The briefing is held because its role-membership guidance offers group assignment without Microsoft's commercial-cloud restriction, despite also covering government tenants. The roadmap facts and printed control paths and commands are supported, but the predicted location of the new role in existing role groups is not documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the new role takes effect automatically or requires tenant action.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Global Reader as able to view all settings and administrative information across Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Global Reader | The read-only version of the Global administrator role. View all settings and administrative information across Microsoft 365.
claims.fix: Replace the quoted breadth with 'Microsoft describes Global Reader as able to read settings and administrative information across Microsoft 365 services, with documented limitations.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference#global-reader, which lists exceptions including Defender content search and Secure Score and several Teams admin center areas.

claims.claim: Security Reader members have read-only access to many security features.
claims.quote: Members have read-only access to many security features of Identity Protection Center, Privileged Identity Management, Monitor Microsoft 365 Service Health, and the Defender and compliance portals.

claims.claim: The Purview permissions page says an Entra role takes precedence over a scoped Purview role group assignment at runtime, resulting in unscoped effective permissions.
claims.quote: the Entra role takes precedence at runtime. As a result, the user's effective permissions are unscoped, even if a scoped Microsoft Purview role group assignment also exists.
